memory_candidates: IForces (Cslib Propositional Kripke.lean) resolves [Preorder World] via typeclass search at theorem-type elaboration time; instantiating at World=Nat locks in Nat.instPreorder (total, unbounded) with no possibility of local override via letI/haveI inside a proof body, since the goal type is already fixed before the proof starts.

A total (linear) Preorder instance cannot represent a non-linear (tree/DAG-shaped) Kripke accessibility relation, regardless of relabelling -- this is a hard type-theoretic limit, not a missing-proof gap. Relevant to any future intuitionistic/modal completeness development that tries to reuse a flat Nat-labelled carrier with the ambient order as accessibility.
